ideas.pitch: Real-time crowd-sourced and predictive safe navigation app for women traversing unfamiliar urban areas at night.
ideas.problem_statement: Women's Safety: Personal safety, emergency response, cyber harassment and safer public spaces.
ideas.title: AegisRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a live, highly demonstrable routing engine and immediate real-world impact, leveraging a working prototype map interface similar to winning transit and dispatch tools.

ideas.pitch: A localized hormonal and menstrual health tracking web app providing automated medical disclaimers and localized clinic locators for rural and urban women.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare: Menstrual health, maternal care, reproductive health and mental well-being.
ideas.title: CycleSync & Care
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a critical, often-overlooked health gap with a clean, highly polished UI and clear, measurable privacy-first architecture.

ideas.pitch: A localized digital platform connecting women-led smallholder agricultural co-ops with climate-resilient farming advisories and direct market access.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability and Climate: Sustainable solutions addressing climate challenges affecting women.
ideas.title: EcoKisan Women
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly links gender equity with climate adaptation, presenting judges with a concrete socio-economic impact metric.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interactive digital literacy and sign language learning platform tailored specifically for hearing-impaired women entering STEM.
ideas.problem_statement: Accessibility: Assistive technologies and improved access to essential services.
ideas.title: SignLearn Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines accessibility with education, deploying real-time feedback loops that demonstrate genuine technical execution within a tight window.

ideas.pitch: A gamified financial literacy and micro-credit readiness tracker designed for women micro-entrepreneurs starting independent small businesses.
ideas.problem_statement: Financial Inclusion: Financial literacy, entrepreneurship and economic independence for women.
ideas.title: FinHer Micro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a clear economic impact story with an interactive dashboard that judges can immediately test and understand during the demo.
